definitions:
Any of the family Portulacaceae (order Caryophyllales) of succulent plants.

common purslane or summer purslane (Portulaca oleracea), a widely-grown edible plant
moss-rose purslane, moss rose (Portulaca grandiflora)

blocks.text: Purslane is a common name for several mostly unrelated plants with edible leaves and may refer to:

items:
Portulacaceae, a family of succulent flowering plants, and especially:
Portulaca oleracea, a species of Portulaca eaten as a leaf vegetable, known as summer purslane
Portulaca grandiflora, moss rose, or moss-rose purslane
Portulaca oleracea, a species of Portulaca eaten as a leaf vegetable, known as summer purslane
Portulaca grandiflora, moss rose, or moss-rose purslane
Claytonia perfoliata, miner's lettuce or winter purslane
Honckenya peploides, also called sea purslane
